# Prism 1.30.0

Unmodified files from the `prismjs@1.30.0` npm distribution, licensed under MIT (see `LICENSE`).
Source: https://github.com/PrismJS/prism/tree/v1.30.0
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/prismjs/-/prismjs-1.30.0.tgz

Included: core, Nix and TOML grammars, Line Numbers, and Line Highlight.
The site serves these assets locally; no CDN or runtime package download is needed.
`../../code-examples.js` adapts Sphinx markup to Prism; `../../code-examples.css` integrates the site palette.
